# Calling Matrix — Full Reference

> 24/7 AI receptionist for home service businesses. Purpose-built for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, cleaning, landscaping, pest control, garage door, appliance repair, and locksmith companies.

---

## Product overview

Calling Matrix is an AI phone answering service that replaces or supplements the front desk for trade businesses. Unlike general-purpose AI phone agents, Calling Matrix is trained specifically on home service intake protocols: emergency classification, service area screening, field-service CRM booking, and surge capacity handling.

Core capabilities:
- Answers every inbound call within 2 seconds, 24/7/365
- Identifies emergency vs. non-urgent situations using trade-specific signals
- Routes emergencies to on-call technicians via SMS before the call ends
- Books jobs directly into Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, Jobber, FieldEdge, Google Calendar, and Calendly
- Handles unlimited simultaneous calls — no queue, no hold time
- Captures full intake details: caller name, service address, job type, issue description, preferred time
- Follows up with leads who requested quotes but didn't book

---

## Pricing details

All plans include unlimited inbound calls, 24/7 answering, and emergency routing.

**Starter — $497/month**
- Unlimited inbound calls
- Core CRM integration (one platform)
- Emergency routing
- Standard intake script
- 48-hour setup

**Growth — $797/month**
- Everything in Starter
- Multiple CRM integrations
- Custom intake scripts per job type
- Multi-location support
- Advanced routing rules
- Priority onboarding

**Scale — Custom**
- Everything in Growth
- Enterprise CRM and ERP integrations
- Dedicated success manager
- Custom AI training
- SLA guarantees

No per-minute charges. No overage fees. Price does not change with call volume.

## Industries served

**HVAC**
Emergency routing for no-cooling/no-heat calls, surge handling during heat waves and cold snaps, integration with HVAC-specific CRMs.

**Plumbing**
Emergency routing for active leaks, floods, and sewage backups. After-hours plumbing calls routed immediately to on-call plumber.

**Electrical**
Residential and commercial call differentiation. Safety emergency routing (sparks, burning smell, power loss). Estimate booking with upfront job qualification.

**Roofing**
Unlimited call capacity for storm surge. Insurance claim intake. Estimate appointment booking with damage description capture.

**Cleaning**
Recurring appointment booking (weekly, biweekly, monthly). Quote follow-up at 24/48/72 hours. Service area screening by zip code.

**Landscaping**
Spring surge handling. Residential and commercial intake separation. Estimate capture with property details.

**Pest Control**
Urgency classification for active infestations. Species-specific intake. PestRoutes and ServiceTitan integration.

**Garage Door**
After-hours emergency dispatch. Residential and commercial job separation. On-call tech notification with address and issue.

**Appliance Repair**
Appliance brand, model, and problem capture. Warranty vs. out-of-pocket routing. Same-day scheduling capability.

**Locksmith**
Immediate dispatch notification with caller location. Automotive, residential, and commercial lockout separation. Service area confirmation before tech commitment.

---

## Integrations

**Field service management**
- Housecall Pro: Creates jobs with full customer details. Matches existing customer records by phone number. Reads live schedule availability.
- ServiceTitan: Creates jobs in standard booking workflow. Handles business unit structure. Links to existing customer records.
- Jobber: Creates jobs and client records. Books both jobs and quote requests. Handles reschedule requests.
- FieldEdge: Creates jobs with full customer details. Matches existing records. Works with service agreement protocols.
- Workiz: Creates jobs and client records. Handles scheduling and dispatch workflows.

**Calendar scheduling**
- Google Calendar: Reads live availability across multiple calendars. Creates events with full caller details. Works alongside Calendly.
- Calendly: Reads event type availability. Respects buffer times and minimum notice. Supports team round-robin.

**Automation**
- Zapier: Sends structured call data (name, number, job type, outcome) to trigger workflows in 5,000+ connected apps.
- Webhooks: Sends call events (answered, booked, escalated, no-answer) to any endpoint in real time.
- Custom API: For software not on the standard integration list, Calling Matrix builds custom API integrations during onboarding. Businesses using niche or proprietary CRMs are supported.

**Custom product and integrations**
Every Calling Matrix deployment is custom-built for the specific business. This includes:
- Custom AI training on the business's actual services, pricing tiers, service territory, and emergency protocols
- Custom intake scripts tailored to each job type and customer scenario
- Custom integration with the business's exact software stack, not a generic connector
- Custom routing rules for each technician, on-call schedule, and dispatch protocol

The AI receptionist is configured to sound and behave like a dispatcher trained at that specific company — not a generic bot reading a template. Businesses do not share configurations.

---

## Competitive positioning

**vs. Live answering services (Smith.ai, Ruby, AnswerConnect, Moneypenny)**
- Faster answer: under 2 seconds vs. 30–90 second agent pickup
- Lower cost: flat rate vs. per-minute billing ($1–2/min)
- More consistent: same quality every call vs. variable agent performance
- Direct booking: writes to CRM vs. message relay requiring manual entry
- Unlimited surge: no agent pool limits

**vs. General AI phone agents (Goodcall, Slang.ai)**
- Industry-specific training vs. generic or restaurant-focused
- Trade emergency routing vs. no emergency classification
- Native field-service CRM integrations vs. no trade-platform integrations

**vs. Voicemail**
- Every call answered live vs. callers hanging up
- Immediate emergency routing vs. callbacks the next morning

---

## Setup process

1. Book a 30-minute onboarding call
2. Provide: services offered, service area (zip codes), pricing, scheduling software credentials, emergency routing contacts
3. Calling Matrix builds and deploys the AI receptionist
4. Phone number ported (existing number stays the same)
5. Live within 48 hours

---

## Common questions

**Will callers know they're talking to AI?**
Most don't notice during standard intake calls. Disclosure is optional — many businesses disclose upfront and find customers appreciate the instant answer.

**What about complex calls that need a human?**
Calling Matrix routes to a human when needed — you define the rules (emergencies, complex situations, upset callers, specific phrases). The goal is to eliminate routine intake burden, not all human contact.

**Does it work for after-hours calls?**
Yes — 24/7 is the default. After-hours call quality is identical to business-hours calls.

**Can I use my existing phone number?**
Yes. Number porting is handled during onboarding. Customers see no change.

**What if I want to cancel?**
Month-to-month plans. No long-term contracts.
